repair_only: compare cross-session outcomes using per-arm offsets from planner_start_ns; never compare absolute monotonic timestamps across sequential sessions

retained_prior_outcomes.v3: raw complete; original PASS label not used for causal interpretation because classifier was order-sensitive
retained_prior_outcomes.v4: raw complete; original HOLD exposed the cross-session absolute-clock bug

source_state: first exact/typed observation after fixture load; require health=97
guard: strict arm cancels on first fresh typed health < source health; owner deadline active in both arms

decision.PASS_SINGLE_PAIR_CANDIDATE: hard gates pass, normalized guard authority-end offset is earlier, guard kill_count >= deadline kill_count, guard death_count <= deadline death_count, and no earlier normalized negative independent event
decision.REJECT_SINGLE_PAIR: hard gates pass and guard kill_count < deadline kill_count or guard death_count > deadline death_count or guard has earlier normalized negative independent event
decision.HOLD: valid but guard non-exposed or ordering not informative

claim_scope: measurement-repaired one-pair zero-model mechanism evidence; population efficacy unproven
